_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Every option and its default is documented in src/core/config.mjs. Credentials do NOT go here — store them with: node src/cli.mjs secret set <name> <value>

gatewayCheck._comment: SET THESE. Without reference hosts the monitor cannot tell its OWN network outage from a camera outage, and will report both identically.

detect._comment: confirmDownCycles=2 means a camera must fail twice running before anyone is alerted. Setting it to 1 disables flap protection.

channels._comment: Enable ONE WhatsApp route and, as a backup that never breaks, Telegram.

whatsappGreen._comment: Hosted gateway. Supports real groups. chatId ends in @g.us.

whatsappWaha._comment: Self-hosted (Docker). Supports real groups. No third party sees your messages.

whatsappWeb._comment: No server needed. Run: npm i whatsapp-web.js qrcode-terminal && node src/cli.mjs wa-login

webhook._comment: Wire into n8n, Make, a ticketing system or an SMS gateway. Payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed.
